name: Uttar Poorva Transformative Industrialization Scheme
benefit:
- Capital Investment Incentive (CII) -  30% of the eligible P&M in Zone A and 50% in Zone B.
- Capital Interest Subvention (CIS) - 3% interest subvention in Zone A and 5% in Zone B for a period of 7 years. 
- Manufacturing & Services Linked Incentive (MSLI) - All eligible units of Zone A & Zone B will be granted MSLI equal to 100% of the Net payment of GST, i.e. GST Paid less Input Tax
_eligibility_text: > As per detailed scheme guidelines including minimum investment, legal entity status, fulfilling requirements viz. registered lease dead, GST details, various reports such as DPR, BAR etc.
